source: github.com/sumedhkumar/sumedhkumarQP (Sumedh Kumar, 15 Nov 2026) — backend/core/strategy.py, risk.py, paper_engine.py
notes: Stop-hunt reversal, XAUUSD. M5 pe levels: PDH/PDL, Asia range (00–07 UTC), 4H swings, equal highs/lows (M15). Wick level ko 10–25 pips ($1.0–$2.5) paar kare aur 3 candle ke andar body ≥ 1.2× avg ke saath close wapas andar → entry. SL wick + 5 pips, TP1 1:2 (50% close + BE), TP2 agla liquidity pool (≥ 1:3), TP1 ke baad trailing (close − 1R). Risk 1%/trade, max 2 open, daily DD 4% pe nayi entry band, sirf London/NY, confidence ≥ 7, level cooldown 30 min.
